mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND id != #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(username, password, real_name, phone, email, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.delete: UPDATE sys_user SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.status = 1
